{"source":"def investigate(context, acquire):
    actions = context.get('actions')
    if actions is None:
        actions = []
    seq = 0
    present = set()
    open_tx = False
    saved_seq = 0
    saved_present = set()
    for action in actions:
        op = action.get('op')
        if op == 'put':
            ident = action.get('id')
            present.add(ident)
            if seq < ident:
                seq = ident
        elif op == 'delete':
            ident = action.get('id')
            if ident in present:
                present.remove(ident)
        elif op == 'begin':
            open_tx = True
            saved_seq = seq
            saved_present = present.copy()
        elif op == 'commit':
            open_tx = False
            saved_seq = 0
            saved_present = set()
        elif op == 'rollback':
            open_tx = False
            seq = saved_seq
            present = saved_present.copy()
            saved_seq = 0
            saved_present = set()
    return seq + 1
